svg.aria-label: Tom Klotz, software engineer at Photoroom in Paris. An animation removes the background from his portrait and swaps in AI backgrounds made with Photoroom, outer space then Paris at dusk. Then a git graph of his career: Algolia, CastorDoc, Ministère des Armées, Photoroom. Highlights: Rookie of the Year in his first 4.5 months, 570+ pull requests merged and 540+ reviewed in 8 months, shipped Virtual Models, AI Video Gen, Share Links and Recommended edits, Code Connect coverage from 22% to 95%.
svg.text: I ship features in Photoroom's AI photo editor,
used by millions to make their photos shine.
Before that: search at Algolia, data at CastorDoc,
